data.name: Pom-Pom
data.description:
Name: Pom-Pom
Nicknames: Pom. Rookie. Fluff-Mountain.
Species: Pomeranian Dog
Age: 28
Actual size: Varies between 1000 - 10,000m
Scaled size equivalent: 6ft 6''
Powers and Abilities: Size growth. 
Nationality: British
Current Residence: Her sisters house is her mooch pad, but her location varies seasonally. She's always close to the coastlines.
Job: Freelance Beach Lifeguard who contracts out to the Coastguard ...and part time Mountain rescue.
Likes: The beach and water related fun/sports. Sunbathing. Playful pranks. Sleeping. Abusing her work position.
Dislikes: Pollution. Being hit on by strangers. Cities. Being told what to do. Cooking and cleaning.
Hobbies: Swimming. Sunbathing. Lifeguarding.
Fav Food: Sundaes. Takeout (if someone else cooks it, it's great in her mind).
Fav Drink: Cherry-Vanilla Milkshake.
Life goals: To own her own tropical resort island, free from rules, regulations and haters. ''A haven for those that want to chillax''.
Relatives: An older sister.

Pom is usually laid back and calm, however she does occasionally abuse her size when provoked.
She is extremely loyal to her friends and is always keen to spend time with and help them out.

As 'attractive' as she is, she doesn't actually like a lot of flattery or comments about her beautiful appearance.  Pom hates being hit on, she'd rather you ask her to play a game, or prank her and have a friendly laugh, than bluntly compliment and point out her looks. She knows she's good looking, so she doesn't need confirmation.
Pom isn't one for romance, receiving flowers or candle light dinners. 
Like most normal people, she's not very keen of random people/strangers thinking its ok to touch and climb on her body. However, she doesn't mind her close friends playing around, as long as they don't abuse her friendship.

Pom takes her job as a lifeguard seriously... most of the time. She has off days where she may abuse her power, mostly due to boredom and authority issues. But, she did choose this career because she genuinely likes saving and helping people, as much as she loves being at the beach.

Pom shares a modern, spacious, beach house with her little sister. She keeps it tidy-ish. Asides from some surfboards, work clothes and marine equipment laying around, no real messes beyond that.
There are a lot of 'fish tanks and aquariums' in the house, as her sister is a marine biologist, who likes to bring work home.

Every item of clothing Pom owns is either black, red, or white... or all 3. Her obsession with being a lifeguard has completely colour co-ordinated her wardrobe!
She only normally wears sporty, beach and outdoorsy clothing. Pom wearing a dress and heels is a big no no. She chooses comfort and practicality over looks.

Pom avoids normal cities and built up areas. With her huge size she would just cause endless accidental devastation. Plus, she hates being yelled and screamed at, not to mention being treated like some kind of monster.
She's not one for rampages and senseless destruction. She will only break things by accident or when she loses her temper as a result of someone else being mean, or assertive towards her.
Most of the time she just wants to relax and play on the beach.
She really enjoys watching over her beach and keeping everyone happy, safe and incheck. Pom will always be keen to join in when invited to play/ref games, swim, or make sandcastles. SHE MAKES A BIG SANDCASTLE!

Pom has little tolerance for people who ruin the beach for others.
Littering and polluting. Perverts, vandals and abusive people will be dealt with depending on her mood. Sometimes they get a time out, sometimes she embarrases them, othertimes she will just blatantly get rid of them (stomp, flick away, thrown away, eaten). Usually she's playful about it as she doesn't want to cause a scene and ruin everyone else's day.
